title: Judge a requirement from current quality evidence
statement: As a reviewer, I can see how each acceptance criterion was tested and whether the evidence is current, so that I can judge confidence without treating progress as proof.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each test case lists the acceptance criteria it verifies.
Each test case presents its steps in execution order.
Each test case states one expected result.
Each test result identifies the test revision it ran.
Revising a test marks its earlier passing results stale.
A failed result remains visible until a newer result supersedes it.
Reported work progress does not count as test evidence.
A quality policy lists the test kinds required for one criterion revision.
The quality view shows each required test kind as satisfied, excluded, or missing.
Each quality exclusion states its rationale.
Each quality exclusion cites its authoritative source.
